fields.description: Creek Views III is the third separately identified phase of Azizi’s Creek Views collection in Dubai Healthcare City, within Al Jaddaf. It combines studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments with shared wellness and outdoor facilities. Completion references have changed; earlier brochure dates are not proof of handover.
fields.handover: Q4 2026 · developer release target; portal conflict

research.community: Dubai Healthcare City · Creek Views III
overview: The branded factsheet and developer release describe 290 planned apartments. In its syndicated release dated 22 June 2026, Azizi reported 66% construction completion and targeted Q4 2026; this is a dated developer report, not today’s inspection.
research.locationNote: Dubai Healthcare City, within Al Jaddaf, by Al Khail Road and Dubai Creek. Phase III is distinct from I/II/IV.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 1.5m. Current available stock, selected-unit quote and additional charges remain unverified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 40% at launch and 60% on handover. No current dated primary schedule confirms applicability to a selected home.
research.handoverNote: The branded July 2025 target and portal Ready/July 2025 reference conflict with Azizi’s syndicated 22 June 2026 announcement of 66% completion and a Q4 2026 target. The later developer estimate is shown; actual handover is unverified.
unresolved: Confirm current completion evidence, stock/quote, contractual date, dated instalments, approved charges, parking, furnishing and title terms. Portal Ready/sold-out badges do not resolve the dated developer construction conflict.
Plan totals include balcony/terrace, not independently measured net interiors. Executed unit plans govern dimensions/finishes.

The developer release has a later generic sentence naming Creek Views II; only its explicit III heading and project-specific dated report are used. No other phase’s details imported. Images remain illustrative.
